title: Reverse Words in a String
prompt: Given an input string `s`, reverse the order of the words. A word is a maximal substring of non-space characters. Return a string with the words in reverse order, joined by a single space, with no leading, trailing, or extra interior spaces.
constraints: s contains English letters, digits, and spaces (possibly multiple/leading/trailing spaces).
There is at least one word in s.
hints: Splitting on whitespace and filtering empties handles multiple/leading/trailing spaces cleanly.
Python's str.split() with no arguments already collapses runs of whitespace for you.
After splitting into words, reverse the list and join with a single space.
